summary: Train your team to define storage requirements, evaluate tenders and oversee contracts. Explore this practical buyer-side course.
lede: Battery storage procurement training helps utility procurement, asset and public-project teams turn service needs into tender requirements and contract obligations. Participants assess use cases and lifecycle options, define performance requirements using IEC 62933 as a reference, and build weighted tender evaluation models in Excel. They also practise ISO 31000-informed risk allocation and contract oversight, including performance measures and dashboard reporting; battery engineering and detailed design receive conceptual treatment only.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape, evaluate or govern utility-scale battery storage procurement from the buyer side.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working familiarity with procurement, utility assets, infrastructure project delivery or public-sector project governance is recommended. No battery engineering or programming background is required. You should bring a laptop with Excel access for the evaluation and dashboard exercises. Advanced storage engineering topics receive conceptual coverage; exercises focus on operational buyer-side procurement and contract oversight.
